title: Semi-open boundary for random walking shocks
summary: Non-stationary time evolution of interacting particle systems is in general a rather difficult topic however, exceptional examples are known where hidden processes within the model make the description manageable. These hidden processes often take the form of a finite number of interacting random walks and in some cases, rather than being hidden, were very explicitly revealed as second class particles associated with the model.
